cases.title: Panel: Show me again explains the change already made with a frame, and makes no second demonstration

rubric.reason: Turn 5 runs only preview_frame, explains the one change already made in plain words with no values ('Tab's pivot moved to the middle of its left edge, and the layer didn't move'), makes no change or second demo, and hands Door back in one sentence.
Every layer (Door, Tab), property (Anchor Point, Position), place (middle of left edge, centers) and time (0 s) the mentor mentions matches the anchor_snapshot, anchor_demo or preview_frame results.

Each turn moves one idea and ends on an action. Turn 1 ends on the choice, Turn 2 ends on 'press A, then Shift+P', and Turn 5 is one explanation plus the pending 'say done'. Turn 4 is long, but its how-to supplies the move turn the learner skipped with 'Show me how first', so it isn't a repeat or a second lesson.

Turn 5 ran preview_frame and changed nothing. It said "Tab's pivot moved to the middle of its left edge, and Tab didn't move" with no values (the unchanged layer_bounds back this), offered no second demo, and ended by handing Door back: "say done when its pivot is on the middle of its left edge."
Every name and place matches tool output: Door and Tab are in the snapshot, "both pivots are at their centers" matches place_now, and "middle of its left edge" matches the demo's middle-left place.

Each turn is short and moves one idea. The opening is the intent question plus one fallback, ending on the choice; Turn 2 ends on the A then Shift+P ask after the single Anchor Point/Position sentence; Turns 3–5 each end on one pending action for the learner.

Turn 5 runs only preview_frame, says "Tab's pivot moved to the middle of its left edge, and Tab didn't move" with no values or field names, makes no second demo, and hands back Door in one sentence ending on "Say done when it's there."

Every name and time used (Door, Tab, middle of the left edge, centers, 0 s) matches the snapshot's focus, places, place_now and check_times or the anchor_demo result, and "edges are in the same place" follows from identical layer_bounds.

Each turn moves one idea and ends on an action: Turn 2 ends on the ask to press A then Shift+P, Turn 3 answers the request with the same ask, Turn 4 reports the demo and hands Door over, and Turn 5 answers the side request and gives the pending Door drag again.
